# Simon Crowcroft

Simon Crowcroft is the current Connétable of [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 1996.

Simon Crowcroft has participated in 7 elections since 2002:

- [**2004 St Helier Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e32)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier unopposed.
- [**2008 St Helier Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e9)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier with 89.7% of the vote.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier unopposed.
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e14)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier unopposed.
- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier unopposed.
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/simon-crowcroft-3/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=enfA5ur12gQ)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Helier with 56.1% of the vote.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/simon-crowcroft/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eSajwlMjRE)

## Election History

### 2004 St Helier Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier) (1 seat), 16th November 2004.

**Simon Crowcroft was elected as Connétable of St Helier in 2004 unopposed**.

- [https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2004/11/17/town-constable-is-elected-for-a-second-term/](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2004/11/17/town-constable-is-elected-for-a-second-term/)

### 2008 St Helier Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier) (1 seat), 9th January 2008.

**Simon Crowcroft was elected as Connétable of St Helier in 2008**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Simon Crowcroft** |  | 2,317 | 89.7% |
| 2 | [Alvin Aaron](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alvin-aaron) | [Jersey Democratic Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-democratic-alliance) | 253 | 9.8% |
| 3 | ~~[Darius Pearce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/darius-pearce)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

2,582 votes (inc. 12 spoilt papers)

13,589 registered voters

= 19% turnout
